title: Forge of Darkness
author: Steven Erikson
review:
DNF 42%. This is a self-indulgent book weighed down with way too much philosophizing at the expense of characters and plot. Every character will stop on a dime to think about the nature of good and evil, religion, politics; you name it. Even after facing a life or death situation. The main Malazan series at least had a balance but this is off the deep end.

The writing is beautiful, but this is a pain to get through. Was really interested in learning more about the ancient Malazan races but even major plot points here are an enigma and always told in the most impenetrable way possible.
